content: API key storage in Tauri: Never hardcode in frontend JS (DMG/installer easily unpacked), tauri-plugin-store writes encrypted JSON but keys still accessible to determined users, keyring crate wraps OS credential stores (Windows Credential Manager, macOS Keychain) with single API, Stronghold plugin encrypts with user password but moves the secret-storage problem one level up. Best practice: user provides own API key, store in OS keychain via keyring, never expose to frontend JS, read only in Rust backend.
